title: Asking About a Job Opening
situation: A job seeker asks a shop manager whether a job opening is available.
somali_situation: Qof shaqo raadinaya ayaa maamule dukaan weydiinaya haddii shaqo bannaan jirto.
key_phrases: Do you have a job opening?

dialogue.speaker: Job Seeker
dialogue.english: Do you have a job opening?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.somali: Dukaanku hal shaqaale ayuu u baahan yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.english: Good. Bring your phone number tomorrow.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Berri keen lambarkaaga telefoonka.

title: Filling Out a Job Application
situation: An applicant asks for help completing a job application form.
somali_situation: Codsade ayaa caawimaad ka codsanaya buuxinta foom codsi shaqo.
key_phrases: I need to complete this application.
You can submit the form today.

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.english: I need to complete this application.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay inaan buuxiyo codsigan.

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.english: Where do I write my experience?

dialogue.speaker: Staff Member
dialogue.somali: Haa, hal tixraac ayaa ku filan.

dialogue.speaker: Staff Member
dialogue.english: You can submit the form today.

title: Improving a CV
situation: A job seeker asks a mentor to review a CV before applying.
somali_situation: Qof shaqo raadinaya ayaa lataliye ka codsanaya inuu eego CV ka hor codsiga.
key_phrases: Put your skills near the top.
This CV is easier to read now.

dialogue.speaker: Job Seeker
dialogue.somali: CV-gayga ma dib u eegi kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Mentor
dialogue.english: Yes. It has a good start.

dialogue.speaker: Mentor
dialogue.english: Put your skills near the top.

dialogue.speaker: Job Seeker
dialogue.english: This CV is easier to read now.
dialogue.somali: CV-gan hadda wuu ka fudud yahay in la akhriyo.

dialogue.speaker: Mentor
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Hadda waad codsan kartaa.

title: Answering Interview Questions
situation: An applicant answers interview questions and asks about training and the next step.
somali_situation: Codsade ayaa ka jawaabaya su'aalo wareysi wuxuuna weydiinayaa tababar iyo tallaabada xigta.
key_phrases: Thank you for inviting me to the interview.
Can you tell me about your experience?
My strength is helping customers stay calm.
What training do new staff receive?
We will discuss the schedule next.

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.english: Thank you for inviting me to the interview.
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad wareysiga ii yeertay.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.english: We are happy to meet you.
dialogue.somali: Waan ku faraxsanahay inaan kula kulanno.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.english: Can you tell me about your experience?

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.english: I worked in a busy grocery shop for two years.
dialogue.somali: Laba sano ayaan ka shaqeeyay dukaan raashin oo mashquul ah.

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.english: I learned to listen before solving a problem.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan bartay inaan dhageysto ka hor xallinta dhibaato.

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.english: My strength is helping customers stay calm.
dialogue.somali: Xooggeygu waa inaan macaamiisha ka caawiyo inay degganaadaan.

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.english: That sounds like work I can do well.
dialogue.somali: Taasi waxay u muuqataa shaqo aan si fiican u qaban karo.

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.english: What training do new staff receive?
dialogue.somali: Tababar noocee ah ayay shaqaalaha cusub helaan?

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.english: They receive one week of training.
dialogue.somali: Waxay helaan hal toddobaad oo tababar ah.

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.english: That would help me learn your system.
dialogue.somali: Taasi waxay iga caawin lahayd inaan barto nidaamkiinna.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.english: We will discuss the schedule next.
dialogue.somali: Jadwalka ayaan xiga ka hadli doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.english: Good. We will contact you tomorrow.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Berri ayaan kula soo xiriiri doonaa.

title: Finding Your Office Desk
situation: A new worker finds their desk and basic office supplies.
somali_situation: Shaqaale cusub ayaa helaya miiskiisa iyo agabka aasaasiga ah ee xafiiska.
key_phrases: Your desk is by the window.
Office supplies are in the cabinet.

dialogue.speaker: Coworker
dialogue.english: Your desk is by the window.

dialogue.speaker: Coworker
dialogue.english: Office supplies are in the cabinet.
dialogue.somali: Agabka xafiisku wuxuu ku jiraa kabadhka.

title: Joining a Work Meeting
situation: A coworker joins a work meeting and asks where to sit and what to prepare.
somali_situation: Shaqaale ayaa ku biiraya shir shaqo wuxuuna weydiinayaa meesha la fariisto iyo waxa la diyaariyo.
key_phrases: What time does the meeting start?
The agenda is on the table.

dialogue.speaker: Coworker
dialogue.english: What time does the meeting start?

dialogue.speaker: Team Lead
dialogue.english: The agenda is on the table.

title: Asking About Salary and Pay Day
somali_title: Mushahar iyo maalinta lacagta oo la weydiinayo
situation: A new worker asks HR about salary, deductions, and pay day.
somali_situation: Shaqaale cusub ayaa HR weydiinaya mushahar, lacag laga jaro, iyo maalinta lacagta.
key_phrases: Can we talk about my salary?
Pay day is the last Friday of the month.
The tax deduction is shown on your payslip.
Please add your bank account to the contract.

dialogue.speaker: New Worker
dialogue.english: Can we talk about my salary?

dialogue.speaker: HR Officer
dialogue.english: Yes, what would you like to know?

dialogue.speaker: New Worker
dialogue.somali: Mushaharka ma bil kasta ayaa la bixiyaa?

dialogue.speaker: HR Officer
dialogue.somali: Haa, bil kasta ayaa la bixiyaa.

dialogue.speaker: HR Officer
dialogue.english: Pay day is the last Friday of the month.
dialogue.somali: Maalinta lacag-bixintu waa Jimcaha ugu dambeeya ee bisha.

dialogue.speaker: New Worker
dialogue.somali: Canshuurta marka hore ma laga jarayaa?

dialogue.speaker: HR Officer
dialogue.english: The tax deduction is shown on your payslip.
dialogue.somali: Lacagta canshuurta laga jaray waxay ku muuqataa warqadda mushaharkaaga.

dialogue.speaker: New Worker
dialogue.english: Do you need my bank details?
dialogue.somali: Faahfaahinta bangigayga ma u baahan tahay?

dialogue.speaker: HR Officer
dialogue.english: Please add your bank account to the contract.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan akoonkaaga bangiga ku dar heshiiska.

dialogue.speaker: HR Officer
dialogue.english: Good. Then payroll can process it.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Markaas qaybta mushaharku way maamuli kartaa.

title: Requesting Leave for Family Reasons
situation: An employee requests leave, explains the dates, and agrees to hand over tasks before leaving.
somali_situation: Shaqaale ayaa codsanaya fasax, wuxuu sharxayaa taariikhaha, wuxuuna oggolaanayaa inuu hawlaha wareejiyo ka hor bixitaanka.
key_phrases: I need to request leave for family reasons.
I can prepare a handover note.
Please finish the urgent tasks first.

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.english: I need to request leave for family reasons.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay inaan fasax u codsado arrimo qoys.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.english: I understand. Which dates do you need?
dialogue.somali: Waan fahmay. Taariikho noocee ah ayaad u baahan tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.english: From Monday to Wednesday next week.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.english: Is anything urgent due before then?
dialogue.somali: Wax degdeg ah ma jiraa oo ka hor wakhtigaas la rabaa?

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.english: One report is due on Friday.
dialogue.somali: Hal warbixin ayaa Jimcaha la rabaa.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.english: Please finish the urgent tasks first.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan marka hore dhammee hawlaha degdegga ah.

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.english: I can prepare a handover note.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan diyaarin karaa qoraal wareejin ah.

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.english: Should I send the request by email?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.english: Yes, send the leave request today.

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.english: I will include the dates and tasks.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan ku dari doonaa taariikhaha iyo hawlaha.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.english: Good. I will review it this afternoon.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Galabta ayaan eegi doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad fahantay.

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.english: I will be back on Thursday.

title: Wearing Safety Gear
situation: A supervisor reminds a new worker to wear basic safety gear.
somali_situation: Kormeere ayaa shaqaale cusub xusuusinaya inuu xirto qalabka badbaadada aasaasiga ah.

title: Asking About Promotion
situation: An employee asks a manager what is needed for a future promotion.
somali_situation: Shaqaale ayaa maamule weydiinaya waxa loogu baahan yahay dalacsiin mustaqbalka ah.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.english: Yes. Are you interested in a new role?

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.somali: Haa, laakiin hagitaan ayaan u baahanahay.

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.somali: Xirfado noocee ah ayaan u baahanahay?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.somali: Waxaad u baahan tahay xirfado warbixin oo ka xooggan.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.somali: Tababarku wuxuu kaa caawin doonaa inaad diyaar garowdo.
